NAME: Jay
LINE: Forget the rulebook for five minutes, okay? We take the shortcut through the rooftops, beat them to the finish line and then grab tacos after... Deal?

NAME: Andy
LINE: The rooftops? Jay, I'm wearing sandals.

NAME: Jay
LINE: Then you'll be the fastest guy in sandals this city has ever seen!

NAME: Florence
LINE: Ahem. Rule fourteen: no rooftops, no shortcuts and absolutely no tacos before the finish line.

NAME: Andy
LINE: ...Why is the race referee a cat?

NAME: Florence
LINE: Because I am the only one in this city who actually reads the rulebook.

NAME: Marcy
LINE: And I'm the only one who eats it! Mrrrow~ See you at the finish, slowpokes!

NAME: Jay
LINE: She's on Team Pigeon? Since when do cats race for Team Pigeon?!

NAME: Marcy
LINE: Since they offered me unlimited pigeons. Bye bye!

NAME: Andy
LINE: That's it. Sandals or not, nobody beats me to a taco.

NAME: Jay
LINE: That's the spirit! Rooftops, go go go!

NAME: Florence
LINE: Wait! Rule fifteen! Rule sixteen! ...Nobody ever listens to rule sixteen.

NAME: Andy
LINE: I lost a sandal. I lost a sandal on the third roof, Jay.

NAME: Jay
LINE: Mourn it later. The finish line is right below us.

NAME: Marcy
LINE: What?! How did you two get here before me?

NAME: Jay
LINE: Rooftops. Never let a pigeon plan your route.

NAME: Florence
LINE: I declare a tie. Also, every single one of you is disqualified.

NAME: Andy
LINE: Disqualified... and the taco truck just closed.

NAME: Marcy
LINE: Don't worry. I saved you some. Well... mostly the cheese.

NAME: Florence
LINE: Hmph. Rule seventeen: winners share. ...Pass the cheese.
